title: State of the Combined Configuration
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $k$ be a natural number, and choose an optional control state, an input-head position, two families of $k$ work tapes with their head positions, and an output word. The configuration formed by concatenating the two tape families has the chosen optional control state.
